entities.title: On a pull request
entities.summary: Rally is typechecked, tested and built, and every .dev diagram and knowledge file is validated.
entities.trigger: A pull request that changes games/rally outside its .dev folders, or anything under .github/ outside .github/.dev (ci.yml).
checks: npm test: tsc --noEmit, then the node:test suites in test/
No .dev folders in dist/: the build must not ship the folders' documentation
python3 Meta/Agents/Skills/validate_diagrams.py, for the whole repository
The Database migration check, when worker/schema.sql or worker/migrations/ change
notChecked: The games hub's relay and sign-in routes.

entities.title: Deploying, by hand
entities.summary: The owner runs npm run deploy: npm test, then npm run build, then wrangler deploy.
entities.trigger: The owner, on their own machine; nothing deploys from GitHub's runners, on a push to main or otherwise.
secrets: A Cloudflare API token for the icelander.net account (CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, or wrangler login), on the owner's machine
notChecked: The migration gate: .github/scripts/migration-gate.sh ran before every deploy only in the removed Deploy workflow, and npm run deploy does not run it, so the owner makes sure production's database has been migrated before deploying (docs/database-migrations.md).
